Package neqsim.process.util.scenario

Class WellToExportDynamics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.scenario.WellToExportDynamics
public final class WellToExportDynamics extends Object
Fixed-step synthetic well, gathering, separation and oil/gas export reference flowsheet. The finite vessels exchange pressure-driven withdrawals. The well and short gathering line use algebraic deliverability and Beggs-Brill hydraulics. The terminal relief and blowdown pressure is fixed.
Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • WellToExportDynamics

      public WellToExportDynamics()
      Builds and initializes the synthetic field at its nominal well drawdown.

    • WellToExportDynamics

      public WellToExportDynamics(int wellCount, int trainCount)
      Builds parallel wells and independently protected gas export trains at a common host. The nominal total field rate stays fixed as the number of wells or duty trains changes.
      Parameters:
      wellCount - number of producing wells with dedicated gathering lines
      trainCount - number of gas export trains sharing the separator gas space
